Runtime-neutral WikiSkill core. Evolved candidates are staged, never
installed; only `install` writes a skill directory, and it copies just Agent
Skill Mastery Engine's own skill.

positional arguments:
  {transition-matrix,verify-archive,candidate-manifest,observation-candidate,init,skip-seed,seed-observations,rollback-seed,prepare-rollout,record-execution,ingest-rollout,reset-manifest,finalize-baseline,sample,apply-wiki,proposer-context,apply-proposal,gate,abandon-candidate,export,package-untested,eval-run,verify-packet,install,status,recover}
    transition-matrix   Print the total lifecycle matrix
    verify-archive      Verify a normalized staged .skill archive
    candidate-manifest  Print a deterministic candidate manifest without
                        writing an artifact
    observation-candidate
                        Print a review-only reusable-signal candidate without
                        writing Task Observer
    init                Initialize one sealed development domain
    skip-seed           Record that no optional observation seed is used
    seed-observations   Apply one human-approved named observation packet
    rollback-seed       Remove an exact seed before baseline evidence exists
    prepare-rollout     Write hash-bound jobs for one rollout phase
    record-execution    Record one adapter-returned captured execution
    ingest-rollout      Evaluate captured outputs and create one manifest
    reset-manifest      Remove invalid unconsumed evidence, preserving outputs
    finalize-baseline   Consume a valid baseline and enter evolution
    sample              Create deterministic Wiki Maintainer input from train
                        traces
    apply-wiki          Validate and apply one Wiki Maintainer JSON result
    proposer-context    Create the train-only Skill Proposer context
    apply-proposal      Validate one create, patch, or no-action proposal
    gate                Apply strict improvement and confirmation rules
    abandon-candidate   Abandon the current candidate transactionally
    export              Stage a validated active skill; never install it
    package-untested    Stage an explicitly untested skill with approval
    eval-run            Score offline rollouts through one cartridge and print
                        the A2 report
    verify-packet       Verify one Task Observer review packet against its
                        manifest, read-only
    install             Copy Agent Skill Mastery Engine's own skill files into
                        a Claude Code skill directory
    status              Read one domain state without recovery
    recover             Replay one recorded pending transaction

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
